title: A drivable 3D car game built in Unity with zero coding.
author: NimbleFox_AI
selftext: I created this using our tool Nimble Fox, which generates playable Unity games from simple descriptions. Would this be useful in your workflow?

comments.author: agarlington
comments.body:
Yes, I currently use a tool called Summer engine built on Godot's open source that does this. 
Would be definitely interested in trying out AI Unity :)

replies.author: NimbleFox_AI
replies.body: Summer engine seems cool! You can join our waitlist here: [https://nimblefox.ai](https://nimblefox.ai)
